gloss: memorial anniversary; anniversary of a death

definitions.gloss: memorial anniversary; anniversary of a person's death observed with a Buddhist ceremony
definitions.explanation: Specific anniversaries of a death on which memorial services are held. In Japanese Buddhism, these occur at fixed intervals and are important family and religious occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年忌|ねんき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧。
examples.english: The third-year memorial service for my grandfather.

examples.japanese: {年忌|ねんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: At memorial anniversaries, relatives gather and have sutras recited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{年忌|ねんき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Since next year is my mother's seventh-year memorial, I started preparing for the memorial service.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) + {忌|き} (mourning, memorial). Refers to the Buddhist tradition of holding memorial services at specific intervals after death.

MEMORIAL YEAR SCHEDULE:
The major {年忌|ねんき} in Japanese Buddhism are:
- ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧: 1st anniversary
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 3rd year (actually 2 years after death — counts the year of death as year 1)
- ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧: 7th year
- ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧: 13th year
- ⟦{三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}→三十三回忌：29130_sanjuusankaiki⟧: 33rd year (often the final service)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年忌|ねんき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: memorial service
- {年忌|ねんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to hold a memorial service
- {年忌|ねんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to fall on a memorial year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧: Buddhist memorial service — the event itself, while {年忌|ねんき} refers to the anniversary
- ⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧: anniversary of death — the specific date, observed annually; {年忌|ねんき} refers to the special milestone anniversaries
- ⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: Buddhist ceremony — the formal religious service held at a {年忌|ねんき}
